name: Annual Child Find Public Notice
description: Annual written notice in newspapers and other media on child identification activities, available special education services and how to request them, and confidentiality procedures; also published in handbooks and on the District website.
quote: The District's public awareness activities shall include annual publication of a written notice in newspapers and other media notifying residents about child identification activities; available special education services and programs and how to request them; and procedures used to ensure confidentiality of student information.
